title: The Valley of Vision

questions.question: The oracle concerning the valley of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 22:1 (ESV): "The oracle concerning the valley of vision."

questions.question: What do you mean that you have gone up, all of you, to the what?
You who are full of shoutings, tumultuous city, exultant what?
Your slain are not slain with the sword or dead in what?
Therefore I said: "Look away from me; let me weep bitter tears; do not labor to what me?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 22:4 (ESV): "do not labor to comfort me"

questions.question: For the Lord GOD of hosts has a day of tumult and trampling and confusion in the valley of what?
And Elam bore the quiver with chariots and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the what?
Your choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen took their stand at the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 22:7 (ESV): "took their stand at the gates."

questions.question: He has taken away the covering of Judah. In that day you looked to the weapons of the House of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 22:8 (ESV): "weapons of the House of the Forest."

questions.question: And you saw that the breaches of the city of David were many. You collected the waters of the lower what?
But you did not look to him who did it, or see him who planned it long what?
In that day the Lord GOD of hosts called for weeping and mourning, for baldness and wearing what?
Come, go to this steward, to whom, who is over the household?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 22:15 (ESV): "to Shebna, who is over the household,"

questions.question: In that day I will call my servant whom the son of Hilkiah?
And I will place on his shoulder the key of the house of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 22:22 (ESV): "key of the house of David."

key_verse_text: And I will place on his shoulder the key of the house of David. He shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.
